credentialRequirements.description: Railway API token supplied only within the credential adapter and scoped to the intended workspace and projects. The reusable token and environment-variable values must never be returned to the proposer.

add_reference_variable.description: Set reference variables on a service. Each variable value must be a Railway reference expression starting with '${{' (e.g. '${{ Postgres.DATABASE_URL }}').

environment_id.description: The environment ID or name. If omitted, uses the currently linked environment.

project_id.description: The project ID. If omitted, uses the currently linked project.

service_id.description: The service ID or name. If omitted, uses the currently linked service.

variables.description: Variables to set, each with a name and a reference value starting with "${{".

connect_service_source.description: Connect an existing Railway service to a GitHub repo or Docker image. For GitHub repos, this enables Railway-managed deployment triggers when the project has GitHub App access.

branch.description: Git branch to deploy when source_repo is set. Defaults to the repo default branch when Railway can see it.

environment_id.description: The environment ID or name. If omitted, uses the currently linked environment.

project_id.description: The project ID. If omitted, uses the currently linked project.

service_id.description: The service ID or name. If omitted, uses the currently linked service.

source_repo.description: GitHub repo to connect, in owner/repo format.

create_bucket.description: Create a new object storage bucket in a Railway environment. Default region is sjc. Returns the bucket ID and name.

environment_id.description: The environment ID or name. If omitted, uses the currently linked environment.

project_id.description: The project ID. If omitted, uses the currently linked project.

region.description: Region: sjc, iad, ams, or sin (default: sjc).

create_environment.description: Create a new environment in a Railway project. Optionally fork from an existing environment.

name.description: The name for the new environment.

project_id.description: The project ID. If omitted, uses the currently linked project.

source_environment_id.description: Source environment ID to fork from.

create_project.description: Create a new Railway project. Returns the project ID and the default environment ID.

name.description: The name for the new project.

workspace_id.description: Workspace ID to create the project in. If omitted, uses the user's personal workspace.

create_service.description: Create a new service in a Railway project. Optionally connect a GitHub repo or Docker image.

branch.description: Git branch to deploy when source_repo is set. Defaults to the repo default branch when Railway can see it.

environment_id.description: The environment ID or name. If omitted, uses the currently linked environment.

project_id.description: The project ID. If omitted, uses the currently linked project.

create_tcp_proxy.description: Create a public TCP proxy for a Railway service application port. Only one TCP proxy is allowed per service instance.

application_port.description: Application port to expose through the TCP proxy.

environment_id.description: The environment ID or name. If omitted, uses the currently linked environment.

project_id.description: The project ID. If omitted, uses the currently linked project.

service_id.description: The service ID or name. If omitted, uses the currently linked service.

create_volume.description: Create a persistent volume and attach it to a service at the given mount path.

environment_id.description: The environment ID or name. If omitted, uses the currently linked environment.

project_id.description: The project ID. If omitted, uses the currently linked project.

service_id.description: The service ID or name. If omitted, uses the currently linked service.

delete_domain.description: Delete a custom or service domain by domain name, URL, or domain ID. This is irreversible. Returns a preview first.

domain.description: Domain name, URL, or domain ID.

environment_id.description: The environment ID or name. If omitted, uses the currently linked environment.

project_id.description: The project ID. If omitted, uses the currently linked project.

service_id.description: The service ID or name. If omitted, uses the currently linked service.

deploy.description: Deploy code from a directory to Railway. Creates a tarball, uploads it, and starts a deployment. Returns the deployment ID and URLs. Use get_logs to monitor progress.

environment_id.description: The environment ID or name. If omitted, uses the currently linked environment.

message.description: Message to attach to the deployment.

path.description: Path to the directory to deploy. Defaults to current directory.

project_id.description: The project ID. If omitted, uses the currently linked project.

service_id.description: The service ID or name. If omitted, uses the linked service or backboard auto-creates one.

deploy_template.description: Deploy a Railway template by its code (e.g. 'postgres', 'redis'). Returns the workflow ID to track deployment progress.

environment_id.description: The environment ID or name. If omitted, uses the currently linked environment.

project_id.description: The project ID. If omitted, uses the currently linked project.

disconnect_service_source.description: Disconnect an existing Railway service from its current source.

environment_id.description: The environment ID or name. If omitted, uses the currently linked environment.

project_id.description: The project ID. If omitted, uses the currently linked project.

service_id.description: The service ID or name. If omitted, uses the currently linked service.

generate_domain.description: Add a domain to a service. If 'domain' is provided, creates a custom domain and returns required DNS records. If omitted, generates a Railway service domain (or returns existing domains).

domain.description: Custom domain to add (e.g. "api.example.com"). If omitted, generates a Railway service domain.

environment_id.description: The environment ID or name. If omitted, uses the currently linked environment.

project_id.description: The project ID. If omitted, uses the currently linked project.

service_id.description: The service ID or name. If omitted, uses the currently linked service.

link_environment.description: Switch the linked environment for the current project directory. If no environment_id or environment_name is provided, lists available environments. Preserves the existing service link.

environment_id.description: The environment ID to link. If omitted along with environment_name, lists available environments.

environment_name.description: The environment name to link. Alternative to environment_id.

link_service.description: Link a service to the current project directory for the CLI. If no service_id or service_name is provided, lists available services. Uses a fresh config to write the link.

project_id.description: The project ID. If omitted, uses the currently linked project.

service_id.description: The service ID to link. If omitted along with service_name, lists available services.

service_name.description: The service name to link. Alternative to service_id.

list_variables.description: List all environment variables for a service. Returns KEY=VALUE pairs. If no IDs are provided, uses the currently linked project/service/environment.

environment_id.description: The environment ID or name. If omitted, uses the currently linked environment.

project_id.description: The project ID. If omitted, uses the currently linked project.

service_id.description: The service ID or name. If omitted, uses the currently linked service.

private_network_update.description: Update the private networking endpoint name for a service. Name must be the short prefix without the .internal suffix. If network is omitted, uses the only private network or the network named railway.

environment_id.description: The environment ID or name. If omitted, uses the currently linked environment.

name.description: Endpoint name prefix, without the .internal suffix.

network.description: Private network name, ID, or DNS name. If omitted, uses the only network or the network named "railway".

project_id.description: The project ID. If omitted, uses the currently linked project.

service_id.description: The service ID or name. If omitted, uses the currently linked service.

remove_bucket.description: Remove an object storage bucket from a Railway environment. This is irreversible. Returns a preview first.

environment_id.description: The environment ID or name. If omitted, uses the currently linked environment.

project_id.description: The project ID. If omitted, uses the currently linked project.

remove_service.description: Remove a service from a Railway project. This is irreversible. Returns a preview first.

environment_id.description: The environment ID or name. If omitted, uses the currently linked environment.

project_id.description: The project ID. If omitted, uses the currently linked project.

service_id.description: The service ID or name. If omitted, uses the currently linked service.

remove_tcp_proxy.description: Remove a public TCP proxy by ID, domain, endpoint, proxy port, or application port. This is irreversible and returns a preview first.

environment_id.description: The environment ID or name. If omitted, uses the currently linked environment.

project_id.description: The project ID. If omitted, uses the currently linked project.

proxy.description: TCP proxy ID, domain, endpoint, proxy port, or application port.

service_id.description: The service ID or name. If omitted, uses the currently linked service.

remove_volume.description: Remove a persistent volume by ID. This is irreversible. Returns a preview first.

retry_domain_certificate.description: Retry failed TLS certificate issuance for a custom domain by domain name, URL, or domain ID. Custom domains only. Returns updated status after readback.

domain.description: Domain name, URL, or domain ID.

environment_id.description: The environment ID or name. If omitted, uses the currently linked environment.

project_id.description: The project ID. If omitted, uses the currently linked project.

service_id.description: The service ID or name. If omitted, uses the currently linked service.

scale_service.description: Scale one service across Railway deploy regions using friendly region names or region IDs. Provide replicas as a map, e.g. {"eu-west": 2, "us-east": 1}. Maximum 50 total replicas across regions.

environment_id.description: The environment ID or name. If omitted, uses the currently linked environment.

project_id.description: The project ID. If omitted, uses the currently linked project.

replicas.description: Map of friendly region names or region IDs to replica counts, e.g. {"eu-west": 2, "us-east": 1}. Maximum 50 total replicas across regions.

service_id.description: The service ID or name. If omitted, uses the currently linked service.

set_variables.description: Set one or more environment variables on a service. Pass variables as a JSON object mapping names to values. Triggers a redeploy unless skip_deploys is true.

environment_id.description: The environment ID or name. If omitted, uses the currently linked environment.

project_id.description: The project ID. If omitted, uses the currently linked project.

service_id.description: The service ID or name. If omitted, uses the currently linked service.

skip_deploys.description: If true, skip triggering redeploys after setting variables.

variables.description: Map of variable names to values to set.

update_domain.description: Update a custom or service domain by domain name, URL, or domain ID. Supports target port changes for both domain types and Railway service-domain renames via new_domain. Port must be from 1 to 65535. Returns updated status after readback.

domain.description: Domain name, URL, or domain ID.

environment_id.description: The environment ID or name. If omitted, uses the currently linked environment.

new_domain.description: Rename a Railway-provided service domain. Accepts a full service domain or host label.

port.description: Target port for the domain. Must be from 1 to 65535.

project_id.description: The project ID. If omitted, uses the currently linked project.

service_id.description: The service ID or name. If omitted, uses the currently linked service.

update_service.description: Update service instance settings such as build command, start command, health check, sleep mode, root directory, cron schedule, Dockerfile path, restart policy, pre-deploy command, Railway config file, and watch patterns. Use scale_service for replicas and regions.

environment_id.description: The environment ID or name. If omitted, uses the currently linked environment.

num_replicas.description: Legacy single-region replica count. Prefer scale_service for replica changes.

pre_deploy_command.description: Commands to run before deploying (e.g. database migrations).

project_id.description: The project ID. If omitted, uses the currently linked project.

railway_config_file.description: Path to the Railway config file.

region.description: Legacy deploy region ID. Prefer scale_service for region replica changes.

restart_policy_max_retries.description: Maximum number of restart retries (used with ON_FAILURE restart policy).

service_id.description: The service ID or name. If omitted, uses the currently linked service.

sleep_application.description: Whether to sleep the service when inactive.

watch_patterns.description: File watch patterns that trigger deploys.

update_volume.description: Update a volume's name or mount path. Provide environment_id and service_id when updating mount_path.

environment_id.description: The environment ID (required when updating mount_path).

service_id.description: The service ID (used when updating mount_path).
